    },
    {
      "name": "mempool",
      "member": true,
      "evidence": "Resolves memory amplification DoS where transactions in the mempool and orphanage consumed up to ~28 bytes per weight unit.",
      "band": "P1",
      "score": 0.85,
      "reason_tag": "DoS protection",
      "rationale": "Eliminating a 28x memory expansion vector for adversarial witness transactions in the mempool is critical for DoS defense. By storing witness elements serialized, worst-case memory usage drops from ~28 bytes/WU to 1.6 bytes/WU, allowing the mempool to hold 13-15% more transactions under load."
    },
    {
      "name": "mining",
      "member": false,
      "evidence": "Changes in src/node/miner.cpp are mechanical caller updates for the new CScriptWitness interface.",

      "rationale": "Does not touch block assembly or mining interfaces."
    },
    {
      "name": "rpc",
      "member": false,
      "evidence": "Changes in src/rpc/ are mechanical scripted diffs adapting callers to the immutable witness interface.",
      "band": "Unranked",
      "score": 0.0,
      "reason_tag": "cleanup",
      "rationale": "No RPC endpoints, formats, or interfaces are changed."
    },
    {
      "name": "tests",

      "band": "Unranked",

      "rationale": "Test changes follow the primary CScriptWitness refactor and do not modify general test harnesses or infrastructure."
    },

      "name": "tools",

      "evidence": "src/bitcoin-tx.cpp is edited mechanically via scripted diff.",
      "band": "Unranked",
      "score": 0.0,
      "reason_tag": "cleanup",
      "rationale": "Tool logic and CLI capabilities are unaffected."
    },
    {
      "name": "utils",
      "member": false,

      "band": "Unranked",
      "score": 0.0,
      "reason_tag": "cleanup",
      "rationale": "The change is centered on transaction and script primitives rather than general node utilities."
    },
    {
      "name": "validation",
      "member": true,
      "evidence": "Encapsulates CScriptWitness and modifies script interpreter execution to parse witness stacks on the fly as spans.",
      "band": "P2",
      "score": 0.7,
      "reason_tag": "DoS protection",
      "rationale": "Encapsulating CScriptWitness into a compact serialized form protects validation structures from adversarial heap expansion. It alters interpreter execution across consensus paths, and careful review is required to verify span lifetimes and check for validation performance overhead under worst-case stacks."
    },
